parameters.query:
with franja as (
  select case when extract(hour from now() at time zone 'America/Bogota') < 15
              then 'am' else 'pm' end as slot
),
ultima_plataforma as (
  select pr.platform
  from public.fb_posts f join public.products pr on pr.id = f.product_id
  where f.status = 'publicado'
  order by f.created_at desc limit 1
)
select p.id, p.name, p.slug, p.price, p.platform, p.image_url,
       h.last_posted_at, (select slot from franja) as slot
from public.products p
left join lateral (
  select max(f.created_at) as last_posted_at
  from public.fb_posts f
  where f.product_id = p.id and f.status = 'publicado'
) h on true
where p.active
  and p.image_url is not null
  and p.stock > 0
  and p.price > 0
  and not exists (select 1 from public.fb_posts e
                  where e.product_id = p.id and e.status = 'error'
                    and e.created_at > now() - interval '7 days')
  and not exists (select 1 from public.fb_posts d
                  where d.status = 'publicado'
                    and d.post_date = (now() at time zone 'America/Bogota')::date
                    and d.slot = (select slot from franja))
order by h.last_posted_at nulls first,
         (p.platform is not distinct from (select platform from ultima_plataforma)),
         random()
limit 1;

insert into public.fb_posts (product_id, slot, status, fb_post_id, caption)
values ($1, $2, 'publicado', $3, $4);

with prev as (
  select count(*) as c from public.fb_posts
  where status = 'error' and error_code = $2
    and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
),
ins as (
  insert into public.fb_posts (product_id, slot, status, error_code, error_category, error_message)
  values ($1, $3, 'error', $2, $4, $5)
  returning id
)
select (select c from prev) = 0 as alertar, (select id from ins) as log_id;
